info.title: Irbis API
info.description: Backend for the Irbis app and admin web. This document is the contract (ADR-003).

username.description: 3-20 chars a-z 0-9 . _ ; case-insensitive; no leading/trailing dot.

password.description: 6-64 chars, not the username, not a common password.

tripSafety.description: Trip & safety alerts; always on and not writable.

ShareLocation.description: Always trips for now; not writable.

shareLocation.description: Always trips for now; not writable.

avatarUrl.description: Derived from the stored avatar key; null when unset or storage is unavailable.

recoveryPhonePending.description: A recovery phone was added and its code is waiting to be verified.

reasonCode.description: ACCOUNT_BLOCKED only: the block reason category.

retryAfterSec.description: ACCOUNT_LOCKED, RATE_LIMITED: seconds until the client may retry.

reason.description: Why the username cannot be used; absent when available.

newPassword.description: 6-64 chars, not the username, not a common password.

locale.description: Accepted and validated, never written: the account keeps the language set at sign-up.

skipped.description: Parts that were accepted but not written to the account.

withPhonePct.description: Percent of users with a verified recovery phone, one decimal.

total.description: Users matching the filters, ignoring the cursor.

lockedForSec.description: Seconds the log-in lockout still lasts; null when not locked.

newPassword.description: 6-64 chars, not the username, not a common password.

ConditionStatus.description: Weekend condition. Absent until one was computed for the place; null when there is no status.

distanceM.description: Great-circle distance from the origin, metres.

conditionStatus.description: Weekend condition. Absent until one was computed for the place; null when there is no status.

SeasonStatus.description: Empty (not set yet) or 12 months, January first.

distanceM.description: Great-circle distance from the origin, metres.

season.description: Empty (not set yet) or 12 months, January first.

value.description: The measured value (km/h, mm, %, °C, cm or WMO code).

text.description: Closure / override reason when source is closure / manual.

active.description: Not ended, started, and endsAt not passed.

endsAt.description: After startsAt. Omit for an open-ended closure.

expiresAt.description: After now and at most 14 days ahead.

LessonGateKind.description: count: any lessons; tier: lessons of `tier`; all: every lesson.

kind.description: count: any lessons; tier: lessons of `tier`; all: every lesson.

minDifficulty.description: Only check-ins at places of at least this difficulty count.

maxDifficulty.description: Hardest place difficulty this level opens.

newPlacesCount.description: Places whose requiredLevel is this level.

verifiedSpots.description: Null when the next level needs no verified spots.

pendingLevelUps.description: Level-ups not yet seen, oldest first.

key.description: Unique and immutable; level gates use it.

ids.description: Every id of the list, in the new order.

tiers.description: Tiers with at least one published lesson, by order.

completedAt.description: When the run finished on the device; the server time is used when it is in the future or older than 7 days.

attempts.description: Every answer given in the run, wrong ones included.

avatarUrl.description: Null when no avatar is set or storage is unavailable.

homeRegion.description: Only returned when the owner shows their home region.

showStats.description: The owner allows stats on the public profile.

username.description: Case-insensitive; changing it requires currentPassword and ends other sessions.

currentPassword.description: Required only when the username changes.

displayName.description: 2–40 characters; empty or null clears it.

bio.description: At most 150 characters; empty or null clears it.

homeRegion.description: A region or null to clear it.

currentPassword.description: The signed-in account password; wrong answers INVALID_PASSWORD.

title.description: Localized to the account locale, falling back to en.

body.description: Localized like title; null when the row has no body.

data.description: The stored JSON payload, or null.

unreadCount.description: Unread rows for the user across all categories.

elevationDiffM.description: Swap elevation minus the original, metres.

status.description: Current condition; null when none was computed.

opensMonth.description: Next open month when the status is seasonal_lock.

swap.description: Only for a not_now node; null when no go place fits.

chest.description: Null when the path has no nodes.

xp.description: XP this call awarded; 0 when the chest was already open.
